peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 10.7% below its local comparables; 16 of 102 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (82.9): 5.9 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 89 of 108 similar developments with a figure (the same as 1). Context, not scored: resales in 91.7% of months (24 months).

rentalYield.caption: Gross yield = 12 x typical rent / typical resale price for the same size band. Before maintenance, property tax, vacancy and agent fees. Not a return on your cash. Lease: 99 yrs from 2012.

rules.peers: same class, market segment and 100 sq ft size band; original lease 99 years or longer, including freehold and 999-year (short leases excluded)
rules.range: the range from combining the middle half of rents with the middle half of prices (12 x lower-quartile rent / upper-quartile price to 12 x upper-quartile rent / lower-quartile price); not a confidence interval
rules.shortLease: Developments with leases under 99 years are excluded from standard long-lease peer groups.

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $667,500 ($1,437 psf, 462–484 sq ft; 12 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 6 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,529 psf (range $1,328–1,761); 6% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $43,000 less. 2-bedroom: median $1,109,000 ($1,303 psf, 742–882 sq ft; 8 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 7 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,478 psf (range $1,211–1,702); 11.8% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $149,000 less. 3-bedroom: median $1,300,000 ($1,258 psf, 1,033–1,108 sq ft; 5 resales, Jul 2024–Jun 2026); 5 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,466 psf (range $1,251–1,773); 14.2% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $215,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Tampines East MRT about 1,170 m, Upper Changi MRT about 1,670 m; closer than 20 of 116 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 6 within 2 km; nearest East Spring Primary School about 650 m; more than 14 of 116 similar developments (the same as 24). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 2 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 290 m), more than 7 of 116 similar developments (the same as 19); nearest hawker centre Pasir Ris Central Hawker Centre about 2,510 m; nearest park Tampines Eco Green Park about 1,800 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Upcoming on the Cross Island Line: Pasir Ris East MRT about 1,130 m (LTA target 2030) and Loyang MRT about 1,580 m (LTA target 2030), both under construction. Straight-line distances to the planned station sites; entrances are not yet published.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 1 other condo development sold new homes within 2 km (Kassia, 22 new sales, about 130 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 28 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 22 new sales and 367 resales (389 purchases); new sales were 5.7% of these purchases. Subsales (0) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 367 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 43 of 116 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 367 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 456 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−19.5%). Planning-area private resales −4%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
